text:
derek: Heads up — after today's infra rollout the Gatekeeper (OPA) Helm upgrade changed the validating webhook config and the API server is timing out calling it. Seeing a bunch of pods Pending on the GPU nodegroup because Cluster Autoscaler stopped scaling up. Rollout job itself was green though.

aj: can you paste `kubectl get validatingwebhookconfiguration gatekeeper-validating-webhook-configuration -o yaml` and the cluster-autoscaler logs?

derek: pasted output: 
```yaml
apiVersion: admissionregistration.k8s.io/v1
kind: ValidatingWebhookConfiguration
metadata:
  name: gatekeeper-validating-webhook-configuration
webhooks:
  - name: validation.gatekeeper.sh
    timeoutSeconds: 1
    failurePolicy: Fail
    clientConfig:
      service:
        name: gatekeeper-service
        namespace: gatekeeper-system
```
cluster-autoscaler logs: 
```
E1003 14:18:22.123456       1 request.go:123] error when calling api server: Post "https://kube-apiserver:443/...": context deadline exceeded (Client.Timeout exceeded while awaiting headers)
W1003 14:18:22.124000       1 scale.go:456] scale up failed: unable to list pods: webhook timeout
```

toni: that `timeoutSeconds: 1` and `failurePolicy: Fail` looks suspicious after the chart bump. Did we change the Helm values or upgrade chart in gitops?

maria: we promoted gatekeeper chart v4.3.0 via gitops this morning (was 4.2.0). The upstream chart changed defaults for webhook timeout/failurePolicy in the new version. I merged the helm values PR earlier: https://git.redwood/ops/helm/releases/23 (internal).

aj: for immediate mitigation we can patch the validating webhook to `failurePolicy: Ignore` so api server will accept requests if webhook is unreachable. That should stop API calls from failing and let autoscaler and schedulers proceed.

derek: ok applying patch now to avoid more Pending GPU jobs — running: `kubectl patch validatingwebhookconfiguration gatekeeper-validating-webhook-configuration --type json -p '[{"op":"replace","path":"/webhooks/0/failurePolicy","value":"Ignore"}]'`

ops-bot: deploy-bot: Helm release gatekeeper v4.3.0 deployed to cluster-prod via gitops at 2025-10-03T14:12Z

derek: patched + restarted gatekeeper pods. cluster-autoscaler started healthy, seen new nodes provisioning and pods scheduling.

maria: nice. note that we ended up spinning up 3 extra p4d spot nodes while autoscaler caught up — cost spike for the hour. :money_with_wings:

toni: we need a short postmortem and a CI preflight that verifies webhook configs (timeoutSeconds, failurePolicy) during chart upgrades. Also we probably should pin the chart default overrides explicitly in our values to avoid surprises.

infra-ci-bot: CI: helm-values-check failed on gatekeeper values bump (warning) — missing explicit `failurePolicy` override in values.yaml (see pipeline: infra-helm-preflight).

maria: I'll open a ticket for the preflight and add a note to the helm values template.

toni: created ENGINFRA-7123: Add webhook preflight + explicit helm value enforcement (assign derek) https://jira.redwood.com/browse/ENGINFRA-7123

derek: I'll take ENGINFRA-7123. Follow-ups: 1) add helm preflight that parses rendered templates for `failurePolicy`/`timeoutSeconds`; 2) pin helm chart default overrides in our repo; 3) update infra terraform `aws_eks_addon` usage docs to call out webhook-sensitive addons; and 4) schedule a canary rollout to eu1 before global promotion.

aj: can we also run a quick scan for other addons that set `failurePolicy: Fail` by default? Might be multiple charts.

derek: yes will add to the ticket. I'll also put a short postmortem in /incidents with timeline and cost estimate (~$120 extra for spot GPUs + ~2h of engineering ops).

maria: thanks everyone — nice quick mitigation. Let's track the rollback plan for the chart bump in the gitops PR and coordinate the canary later today. :thumbsup:
